title: GRPO group advantages and clipped objective
summary: Normalize rewards within each group, estimate the KL with k3, and compute the clipped GRPO objective averaged per answer over valid tokens.

paper.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models

mutants.k3_ratio_reversed: Uses pi_theta / pi_ref inside k3, so the estimate is no longer unbiased for KL(pi_theta || pi_ref).
mutants.kl_added: Adds beta times k3 to the objective instead of subtracting it.
mutants.max_not_min: Takes the maximum of the unclipped and the clipped surrogate, so the clip never limits the gain.
mutants.no_eps: Divides by the standard deviation without eps, so a group with equal rewards gives NaN.
mutants.sample_std: Uses the sample standard deviation with ddof=1, not the population standard deviation.
mutants.token_level_mean: Averages over all valid tokens of the batch, not over each answer first.
